indications: Uses first aid to help prevent infection in: • minor cuts • scrapes • burns

label.Active ingredient: Active ingredient (each gram contains) Bacitracin 500 units
label.Indications and usage: Uses first aid to help prevent infection in: • minor cuts • scrapes • burns
label.Dosage and administration: Directions • clean the affected area • apply a small amount of this product (an amount equal to the surface area of the tip of a finger) on the area 1 to 3 times daily • may be covered with a sterile bandage
label.Warnings: Warnings For external use only Do not use • in the eyes • over large areas of the body • if you are allergic to any of the ingredients Ask a doctor before use if you have • deep or puncture wounds • animal bites • serious burns Stop use and ask a doctor if • you need to use longer than 1 week • condition persists or gets worse • rash or other allergic reaction develops Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. (1-800-222-1222)
